snippet.title: Jailbirds - OFFICIAL TRAILER
snippet.description:
Jailbirds is now available on Steam!

Experience now one of the most awarded VR fantasy horror narratives. Watch Jailbirds and share this fantastic story with your friends and family.

The Bwa-Kayiman prison is a modern hell, a dehumanizing institution where inmates endure the sadism of a petty CHIEF WARDEN. Yet, despite all the bullying and psychological torture, one inmate, FELIX, is always happy.
🕊️Jailbirds is an experience directed by Thomas Villepoux, produced by Digital Rise, Be Revolution Pictures and France TV.

Jailbirds soundtrack by @g4frecords will be soon available on your favorite streaming platforms.

Discover or rediscover Jailbirds in English, French, and Korean now on Steam.

Watch Jailbirds now and leave us a positive review!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2827920/Jailbirds/
